messages:
Maya: quick update from quant bakeoff — brought up model-redwood-llama2x in int8 & fp8 on dedicated profile B. Seeing a weird accuracy delta on table-extract and date normalization tasks. INT8 shows ~5.8% EM drop vs fp16 baseline; FP8 shows ~3.1% drop but has sporadic date formatting hallucinations.

Josh: can you paste the eval cmd + config?

Maya: here's what I ran:
```bash
./eval-suite run --model redwood-llama2x --profile dedicated-B --quant int8 --tasks table-extract,date-normalize --seed 42 --batch-size 16 --calib-mode static
```

EvalBot: Run complete: 2400 evals, regression detected on tests/table-extract (p=0.0002), regression_count=138

Alex: looked at logits — token-level probs for date tokens shift left when kv_cache rebuilt; saw repeated near-zero probs at the tail for some shard combos. small log excerpt:
```
[shard-02] token_probs: 0.001, 0.002, 0.000, 0.000, 0.45, 0.38
[shard-05] token_probs: 0.002, 0.001, 0.000, 0.000, 0.49, 0.34
```

Rachel: could this be batching/eviction? We recently enabled shared-kv-shards on profile B last week.

Tom: try rerun with --kv-shard-mode=per-request and --batch-size=1 to confirm. Also test quant-calib with dynamic_ranges=8 vs 16.

Maya: rerunning with those flags now. if it reproduces, we should test FP8 + disable aggressive prefix caching (profile opt). Also need to test longform prompts vs short.

Josh: also add canonicalization for dates in eval set to separate formatting vs hallucination — normalize expected outputs to ISO for scoring.

Alex: quick stat: for failing samples, the top-1 token for day-of-month flips from '15' to '01' 72% of the time under INT8. suggests bias towards low tokens.

Rachel: possible cause = asymmetric quant clipping on the embedding matrix; recall PR #4123 changed range estimation for layernorm.

Maya: good call. I'll bisect quant pipeline starting at commit c3f4b2 -> c3f4b8.

EvalBot: Canary job scheduled on dedicated-B-shard-03 at 10:12 UTC

Tom: thanks. keep thread small. ping me when you have repro.

Maya: will do. interim logs: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-llama2x","profile":"dedicated-B","quant":"int8","batch_size":16}
```

Maya: last: if someone can review the calibration hist codepath (alex/rachel?), maybe a quick look at asymmetric vs symmetric per-channel stats.

Alex: on it. starting with per-channel histogram dumps.

Rachel: i'll review PR history.

Maya: thanks :thumbsup:
